title: Very practical !!! I love this!
text: Very practical !!! I love this!. Perfect! I got this on Amazon Prime day and LOVE IT ! I have so many spices and they were just floating around the cupboards and I always was reaching really far just to get to anything, I even forgot I had some sometimes because it was annoying having to take all others out just to look for something. This is super convenient and I have different sizes too and it fits all of them so that's great! The only thing I wasn't thrilled about is that it's very big so it does take up some space on the kitchen, and I definitely had to keep the bigger spice containers out (basically just the chicken bouillon). I really like that it has 3 different levels and there is a lot of space about 10 spices on each level and you can just take them out and look and put back in it's so practical!

product_metadata.title: YouCopia SpiceStack Adjustable Spice Rack 24-Bottle Organizer for Cabinet or Pantry Storage, Granite
features: Organize 24 round or square spice bottles in three drop-down drawers
Three adjustable dividers let you pick the right height to fit spices
Just take the SpiceStack out of the box and start loading spices; Your spice bottles will be organized in mere minutes; No tools, mounting or installation required
Each SpiceStack includes 104 (52 printed and 52 blank) removable drawer labels for custom organization and an even faster find while cooking
Measures 11.0” deep, 10.5” wide, and 8.3” tall; Fits standard- and half-sized spice bottles; Made from high-quality plastic with non-slip feet
